findings.issue: The two spaces in the jp were tokenized as 記号 (kigou) and the reading きごう was injected twice into the phonetic transcription, teaching a nonexistent pronunciation.
findings.current: はしのきごうもちかたをきごうならいました
findings.suggested: はしのもちかたをならいました

findings.issue: Same space-as-記号 corruption as kana: spurious 'kigou' appears twice in the romanization. This is beyond the known punctuation/katakana issue — it adds wrong syllables.
Token whose surface is a plain space is given the reading きごう (記号 'symbol'). Same defect at tokens[6].r. A space has no reading.
'As for everyone' renders みんなが as if が were the topic marker は. が here marks the subject of the subordinate clause 元気でいる; the topic-mirror device misteaches the particle.
findings.current: As for everyone, I pray that they are in good health.
findings.suggested: I pray so that everyone is in good health.

findings.issue: 'Quanto a todos' espelha みんなが como se fosse tópico (は); が marca o sujeito da oração subordinada 元気でいる, então o espelho estrutural está errado.
findings.current: Quanto a todos, rezo de modo que (eles) estejam com boa saúde.
findings.suggested: Rezo de modo que todos estejam com boa saúde.

findings.issue: Register mismatch: polite 楽しみます rendered with informal 'curto' (gíria). Polite JP should map to neutral-polite pt-BR.
findings.current: No inverno, eu curto descer esquiando na montanha.
findings.suggested: No inverno, gosto de descer esquiando na montanha.

findings.issue: Typo/accent error: 'prática' (noun/adjective) used where the verb 'pratica' is required ('o sujeito que pratica o verbo').
findings.current: が aponta o sujeito que prática o verbo
findings.suggested: が aponta o sujeito que pratica o verbo

findings.issue: Inserted subject '(he)' contradicts the natural translations (en 'you were late', pt 'você se atrasou'); the omitted JP subject is the listener in this context.
findings.current: It makes sense, that's why (he) was late, isn't it.
findings.suggested: It makes sense, that's why (you) were late, isn't it.
